title: Property definition
description: One entry in the property registry. Anyone can propose a property by opening a PR that adds an entry with status 'proposed'. Adding properties never changes the core schema.

value_schema.description: A JSON Schema (2020-12) that a value must satisfy.

unit.description: Human-readable unit for display, if the value has one.

half_life_hours.description: How fast the fact goes stale.

writers.description: Who may submit observations. ['system'] alone means derived-only: clients may not write it.

strategy.description: latest_weighted: highest weighted support wins. median: numeric field. mode: most common value. union: merge set values. schedule: newest declared rule wins. derived: computed from other properties.

field.description: For median: the numeric field inside the value.

window.description: For median: how many recent observations to use.

since.description: Schema version in which the property appeared.
